parameters.description: If true, validations are run for the corresponding Configurable Field Set.

200.description: Returns the updated Time And Material Entries

schema.description: Array of Time And Material Entry

id.description: Unique identifier of the Time & Material entry.

name.description: Title of the Time & Material ticket.

reference_number.description: Reference number associated with this Time & Material ticket.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this Time & Material ticket.

private.description: Whether this Time & Material ticket is private (visible only to users with admin-level permissions).

number.description: Auto-assigned sequential number for this Time & Material ticket within its project.

company_signee_party.description: Party designated as the company-side signee for this ticket.

employee_id.description: Employee ID for the Party Person

id.description: Unique identifier for the Party Person.

is_employee.description: Employee status for the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID if this Party Person represents a User. NULL for a Reference User.

company_signature.description: Signature provided by the company-side signee.

signature_text.description: Acknowledgement text the signer agreed to.

url.description: Direct URL to the full-size signature image.

medium_thumbnail_url.description: URL for a medium-sized thumbnail of the signature image.

large_thumbnail_url.description: URL for a large-sized thumbnail of the signature image.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this signature was created, in ISO 8601 format.

customer_signature.description: Signature provided by the customer-side signee.

signature_text.description: Acknowledgement text the signer agreed to.

url.description: Direct URL to the full-size signature image.

medium_thumbnail_url.description: URL for a medium-sized thumbnail of the signature image.

large_thumbnail_url.description: URL for a large-sized thumbnail of the signature image.

customer_signee_party.description: Party designated as the customer-side signee for this ticket.

employee_id.description: Employee ID for the Party Person

id.description: Unique identifier for the Party Person.

is_employee.description: Employee status for the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID if this Party Person represents a User. NULL for a Reference User.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this Time & Material ticket belongs to.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this Time & Material ticket.

location_id.description: Identifier of the project location where work was performed. Null if no location is assigned.

customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer associated with this Time & Material ticket.

work_performed_on_date.description: Date when the work was performed.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this entry was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this entry was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this entry was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

created_by_id.description: Identifier of the user who created this Time & Material ticket.

422.description: Error updating Time And Material Entries

time_and_material_entry_ids.description: Array of Time & Material entry identifiers to update.

items.description: Unique identifier of a Time & Material entry to update.

change_event_id.description: Identifier of the change event to associate with these entries.

update_change_event_attachment.description: Whether to sync attachments to the associated change event.
